product_family: Excalidraw (open-source whiteboard) + Excalidraw+ (paid collaborative workspace with AI)

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: Passed SOC 2 Type I & Type II. We chose Insight Assurance for the audit process.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type 1 and SOC 2 Type 2 reports listed under Resources in trust center; both reports available for download under NDA.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001 (if enough customers ask) — listed as a future compliance goal, not yet achieved.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of HIPAA certification found on trust center, security page, privacy policy, or terms of service.

certifications.name: GDPR (adequacy/SCCs)
certifications.proof_quote: For transfers from EEA/UK, Excalidraw implements EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs). Analytics uses GDPR-compliant SimpleAnalytics.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Stripe processes all payments and is PCI Level 1 certified; Excalidraw does not store card details. Excalidraw itself holds no PCI certification.

privacy.ai_training_note: No clause permitting use of customer drawings or content to train AI models found in the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, DPA, or Description of Processing. The DPA explicitly states the processor 'does not access such content except incidentally when providing the Services or when required by law.' AI features (text-to-diagram, wireframe-to-code) are available in Excalidraw+; users may also supply their own OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or OpenRouter API keys. No explicit statement that third-party model providers are prevented from training on submitted content when using default AI features.
privacy.data_region: United States (primary). EU/UK transfers covered by EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs). Access to Customer Personal Data restricted to authorized personnel within the European Union per DPA.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 encryption at rest for Excalidraw+ customers; access tokens and keys additionally encrypted at the application level before database storage.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS encryption in transit for all Excalidraw+ customer data.

security.name: End-to-end encryption (free tier)
security.value: Shared content in the free/open-source editor is protected by end-to-end encryption; data for non-Plus users is stored in browser local storage only.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual penetration testing performed. 2025 penetration testing certificate and full report available in trust center (NDA required).

security.name: Vulnerability scanning
security.value: GitHub and Vanta used for continuous code vulnerability detection.

security.name: Bug bounty
security.value: No formal bug bounty on HackerOne or Bugcrowd. Vulnerability disclosure via GitHub private advisory reporting. No SECURITY.md published.

security.name: Database backups
security.value: Daily database backups with 14-day point-in-time recovery capability.

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-based access control for organization members; admin controls over workspace access, sharing, and AI usage; unique production database authentication enforced.

security.name: Cybersecurity insurance
security.value: Cybersecurity insurance maintained (listed as a verified internal security procedures control).

security.name: Business continuity
security.value: Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans established and tested.

security.name: CI/CD security
security.value: Scans for service role keys and filters environment variables during builds.

security.name: Subprocessors
security.value: Stripe (finance/payments), DigitalOcean (cloud infrastructure), Vercel (engineering/CDN), Supabase (cloud database). Full list at trust.excalidraw.com/subprocessors.

products.name: Excalidraw (free / open-source)
products.data_scope: No account required. Drawings saved in browser local storage only — no server-side persistence. Shared drawings use end-to-end encryption. No SOC 2 coverage applies to this tier.
products.notes: Open-source (MIT license) and self-hostable. Consumer-grade privacy by design: data never leaves the browser unless the user explicitly shares or exports.

products.name: Excalidraw+ (paid — personal/team)
products.data_scope: Cloud-synced drawings, team workspaces, access control. AES-256 at rest, TLS in transit, SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2 certified. DPA available. AI features included (text-to-diagram, wireframe-to-code, 100 requests/day).
products.notes: Subscription tier. AI model provider for built-in AI features is not publicly disclosed. Users may supply their own API keys (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter) to bypass default AI routing. Data residency is US; EU SCC transfers available.

compare.data_residency: US primary; EU Standard Contractual Clauses available for EEA/UK customers

flags: No formal bug bounty program (HackerOne/Bugcrowd); relies on GitHub private vulnerability reporting.
ISO 27001 not held; explicitly listed as future goal contingent on customer demand.
HIPAA not certified; not mentioned as a goal.
AI model provider for built-in Excalidraw+ AI features is not publicly disclosed; data flow to third-party AI providers is not documented in the privacy policy or DPA.
Data region is US-primary; EU adequacy relies on SCCs, not an EU-based data region option.
Free tier has no SOC 2 coverage — all compliance applies to Excalidraw+ only.
DPA states 'Controller does not have approval or objection rights regarding Subprocessors' — less favorable DPA term for enterprise buyers.
